'''Star Wars CCG teams''' are standing playtest and travel groups of players who test together and show up at majors. They are separate from Decipher's 1990s volunteer [[Squadron Members]], from the Friday two-player Team Tournament format at modern majors, and from the biennial [[Outrider Cup]] geographic all-star sides.

Current published rosters are Joe Olson's pinned Players Committee forum thread ''SWCCG Teams - Rosters'' and its spreadsheet (updated 14 September 2025).<ref name="forum-81218">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=81218 SWCCG Teams - Rosters], Joe Olson (arebelspy), Players Committee Forums (21 July 2022; spreadsheet updated 14 September 2025). Live sheet: [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit?usp=sharing Google Sheets]. Wayback: https://web.archive.org/web/20261008235350/https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit?usp=sharing. Wiki copy: [[:File:SWCCG Teams Rosters 14 September 2025.txt]].</ref> People on more than one team are listed under each team.

Matthew Harrison-Trainor is credited to Team 5 for Texas Mini-Worlds 2020, to KTOD+ for OCS 2021 and Champions League 2022, and to New Allies for OCS 2024. Jeff Lavigne's 2022 Endor Grand Prix win is credited to Killer Bs; the sheet notes he later moved fully to Team 5.

== Outrider Cup ==

The same sheet records [[Outrider Cup]] sides: 2019/20 [[Team USA]] 7–4, Outrider Cup II (2021/22) [[Team Europe]] 6–6 then Europe in sudden death, Outrider Cup III (2023/24) [[Team USA]] 7–5.<ref name="forum-81218">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=81218 SWCCG Teams - Rosters], Joe Olson (arebelspy), Players Committee Forums (21 July 2022; spreadsheet updated 14 September 2025). Live sheet: [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit?usp=sharing Google Sheets]. Wayback: https://web.archive.org/web/20261008235350/https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit?usp=sharing. == Related ==

* '''[[Outrider Cup]]''' — Team Europe vs Team USA / North America, seeded from Player of the Year points and captain's picks.
* '''Friday Team Tournament''' — two-player Light/Dark pairs at majors (for example 2025 Worlds team "Scott Norwood": [[Brian Fred]] and [[Jonny Chu]]).
* '''[[Squadron Members]]''' — Decipher volunteer promoters (Red, Gold, Bravo, Rogue), not competitive playtest rosters.
